lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five longitudinal rows and twelve vertical columns between the branchial region and the second dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges to form a grid-like pattern, with the primary high-luminance blobs centered at these intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light-toned superior edges and shadowed inferior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple high-contrast, elongated objects (likely commensal fish) are visible in the water column immediately ventral to the pectoral fin and mid-body region.
